name: anand-site
description: Marks assets/js/**/*.js as ES modules so the Raft core runs unchanged in Node for tests. Not part of the built site.

scripts.dev: PATH="$(brew --prefix ruby 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" bundle exec jekyll serve
scripts.build: PATH="$(brew --prefix ruby 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build
